rationale: ROUND 2 of f30a28e1 (071 gap 3 residual: persist the warnings a valid build leaves unrepaired). All three round-1 objections answered, one with new code. (1) editquality HIGH — the LogActionEntry landmine ('merge fills a provenance you meant to set'): the landmine's OWN body, quoted in round 1's answered checks, says FIXED AND NOW LIVE — v1.0.1268, pod-proven on BOTH chassis replicas 2026-08-08. The fixed semantics are the reverse of the worry: a provenance the caller SETS is never overwritten; only an ABSENT provenance is handled, and since the fix it is marked 'unattributed' rather than silently filled from the running step. This writer sets AgentType/StepName/Action/ErrorCode explicitly, and — contrary to the objection's reading of the sketch — the pinning test does NOT use AnyArg for those fields: it pins argument positions 5 (agent_type='page-build-handler'), 8 (step_name='validate_content'), 9 (action='validate_page_content'), 11 (error_code) and 12 (severity), plus a context matcher that looks INSIDE the issues array; log_action_error_test.go's own header records that the AnyArg-blind suite was the package's recorded defect and its tests were rewritten to fail on the pre-fix merge. (2) editquality LOW (sketch fidelity): corrected below — the real signature takes siteIDStr and derives siteIDArg internally via uuid.Parse; page_name/page_url are ExtractNestedFieldString reads of page_record.name/.url, exactly as both siblings do. (3) the 'missing' item — an INVALID build's warnings still wrote nothing durable — is a fair catch and is now IMPLEMENTED, not scoped out: writeValidationFailureLog carries the build's warnings on the failure row it already writes, under a SEPARATE context key ('warnings' + 'warning_count') so context.issues keeps its blocker/error-only shape for existing consumers; the set is survivingWarnings(issues, nil), correct because no repair pass has run on the failure path so every warning is unrepaired by construction. A new sqlmock test pins both shapes on the failure row (no warning may leak into issues; both fixture warnings present under warnings). Everything from round 1 otherwise stands: new error_code CONTENT_VALIDATION_WARNING_DETAIL (count 0 today, per round 1's answered check), one row per build, repairsByHref dedupe shared with the annotator, pure filter mutation-proven.
